summary: Documented the reusable Infinigen generated-world quality recipe and updated current status with the new scene-light intensity scale control. No commits were created.
work_completed: Added `docs/importing_and_exporting_assets.md` section `Generated world quality checklist` for active-illumination Infinigen worlds.

Recipe covers real window openings with exterior context, post-import Unreal light actors, neutral imported materials/textures, furniture orientation, collision planning, manageable scene complexity/export resolution, validation counts/bounds, cook/package validation, and live flashlight validation.

Recorded launch-time lighting balance guidance: use `--scene-light-intensity-scale` to dim scene lights without disabling them, use `--indirect-lighting-intensity 0` for the co-located flashlight in small scenes, and tune flashlight intensity/radius/cones per world.

Updated `.control-tower/docs/state/current-status.md` with Builder's `--scene-light-intensity-scale` support, the durable recipe location, and revised cafeteria v2 validation guidance using scene-light scale values `0.2`, `0.1`, and `0.0`.
Verified the docs diff with `git diff --check`.

findings.message: Target docs were already dirty before this task; existing uncommitted content was preserved and the new docs-only edits were layered on top.
Docs-only task; no runtime or unit tests were run.

follow_up_recommendations: Run live cafeteria v2 visual validation with `--scene-light-intensity-scale 0.2`, `0.1`, and `0.0`, then reserve `--disable-scene-lights` for flashlight-only comparison.
memory_worthy: Durable docs now contain a reusable generated-world quality checklist in `docs/importing_and_exporting_assets.md` for future Infinigen active-illumination worlds.
Flashlight launch guidance now prefers `--scene-light-intensity-scale` for dimming existing fixture lights while preserving scene context; `0.0` dims them off without using `--disable-scene-lights`.
Small generated interiors should use `--indirect-lighting-intensity 0` for the spawned co-located flashlight and tune direct flashlight intensity, attenuation radius, and cone angles per world.
